describe.summary: Send mail from the owner's own Gmail address, to the recipients the policy allows, with the owner's confirmation where they asked for it; it cannot read the mailbox.

status.doc: Whether the credential works, the policy with every member it holds, and the caller's own sends today.

params.name: reply_pubkey
params.doc: secp256k1 public key (33 bytes compressed) to seal the policy to when the answer lands on chain.

send.doc: One message, policy-checked, then sent under the owner's address — or, when the owner's policy lists `send` under `confirm`, left as a task for the owner and answered `awaiting_owner`.

params.name: to
params.doc: Bare addresses only: no display names, no angle brackets.

params.name: subject
params.doc: The owner's `subject_prefix`, when the policy sets one, is prepended unless the subject already starts with it; absent, the subject is the prefix alone, or empty without one.

params.name: body
params.doc: Plain text; absent is sent empty.

params.name: attachments
params.doc: {filename, content_type, data: base64}; the policy decides whether attachments go.

confirm.doc: Carried out by a run of the agent that prepared the task, started by the platform on the owner's signed approval and paid by the agent's key: sends the message the task holds, under the policy the task was made under, and counts it in the agent's own cell beside its direct sends. The owner's note, when they wrote one, goes to the agent with the result. A refusal before the task is taken fails it with `run_refused:unreported` (a refusal of the connector's own, which the host never saw) or `run_refused:<reason>` (one of the host's); one after says the task is closed.

params.name: task_hash
params.doc: SHA-256 of the task as the owner's page showed it.

params.name: approval
params.doc: The owner's approval as the platform puts it in the run's input: `at`, `public_key`, `signature`, `nonce`. Verified in the enclave against the task and the owner's account on chain.

params.name: note
params.doc: What the owner wrote beside the approval, sealed to the task's reply key; opened by the host and handed to the agent with the result.

task_status.doc: Where a task this caller made stands: `open`, `approved` (the owner signed; the run started), `answering`, `done` with the result, `failed` with `failure_reason` when it failed before the run acted, `rejected` with the owner's reason, `cancelled`, `expired`, `void`.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task's id, as `send` answered it.

task_cancel.doc: Withdraw an open task this caller made.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task's id, as `send` answered it.

task_delete.doc: Delete a task this caller made that nothing was carried out on: open, cancelled, rejected, expired, void, or failed with a reason that says nothing was done. One the owner's yes acted on, or may have, is refused task_closed — it is the owner's record too.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task's id, as `send` answered it.

tasks.doc: The tasks this caller made for this owner: the open ones and the outcomes kept.

tasks_unlock.doc: The owner's own call: opens the waiting tasks for a device that was not signed in when they were made.
